title: Converting a Database from Version 3 Macintosh to Version 6 Windows

historical_commentary.text: This note addressed a very specific migration path — taking a Version 3 Macintosh 4D database and converting it to Version 6 on Windows. 4D Transporter was a dedicated utility for cross-version and cross-platform database migration, reflecting the significant structural changes between 4D v3 (classic Macintosh-only) and v6 (cross-platform). These version numbers and the Transporter tool itself are ancient history; modern 4D's migration path starts from much later versions, and the concept of a separate Transporter utility no longer exists.
related_updates: 4D Transporter was discontinued; modern 4D handles database upgrades internally during opening
4D v3's database format is multiple generations behind current formats; direct migration from v3 has not been supported for many versions
